Name: Custom Resource Clumps
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod allows you to create custom resource clumps (the game's name for 2x2 farmable stumps and boulders) that have a chance to spawn instead of ordinary boulders. [b]By default it does nothing[/b], you are expected to either install a content pack for it or create your own. Alternatively, it includes a sample file you can rename and use that adds five custom clumps: copper, iron, gold, diamond, and iridium (see below).


[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]

To use this mod with the example clumps, you can simply rename the [b]EXAMPLEcustom_resource_clumps.json[/b] file included with this mod to [b][b]custom_resource_clumps[/b].json[/b] (and optionally edit it with a text editor). [size=5][b]JSON Explanation[/b][/size]

Each JSON object can have the following keys:

[list]
[*]string [b]id[/b]: a text id to identify the clump by (for console spawning, e.g.)

[*]string [b]clumpDesc[/b]: A description of the clump (doesn't do much afaics).
[*]int [b]debrisType[/b]: what sort of crap flies up when it breaks (14 is stone, 12 is wood, I think)
[*]string[] [b]failSounds[/b]: ﻿ a list of sound names to play on a hit with the wrong tool
[*]string[] [b]hitSounds[/b]: a list of sound names to play on a hit with the right tool
[*]string[] [b]breakSounds[/b]: ﻿ a list of sound names to play when the clump is destroyed
[*]int [b]shake[/b]: the rate of time it takes for the clump to vibrate when hit (lower is quicker, 0 turns off shake)
[*]string [b]toolType[/b]: the right tool, one of "[b]axe[/b]", "[b]pick[/b]", "[b]hoe[/b]", "[b]weapon[/b]", "[b]wateringcan[/b]", "[b]wand[/b]". I don't know if they all will work.
[*]int [b]toolMinLevel[/b]: minimum upgrade required to hurt the clump (for weapons, set to 0)
[*]int [b]tileWidth[/b]: how many tiles wide the clump is ([b]must be 2 for now[/b])
[*]int [b]tileHeight[/b]: ﻿how many tiles tall the clump is ([b]must be 2 for now[/b])
[*]string [b]spritePath[/b]: the relative path either to the game or mod sheet containing the sprite
[*]string [b]spriteType[/b]: where to look for the sprite sheet; one of "[b]mod[/b]" or "[b]game[/b]"
[*]int [b]spriteX[/b]: the X-coord of the pixel where the sprite begins on the sheet
[*]int [b]spriteY[/b]: the Y-coord of the pixel where the sprite begins on the sheet
[*]int [b]minLevel[/b]: minimum mine level for the clump to spawn (optional)
[*]int [b]maxLevel[/b]: maximum mine level for the clump to spawn (optional)
[*]float [b]baseSpawnChance[/b]: 0-100
[*]float [b]﻿additionalChancePerLevel[/b]: 0-100 additional chance per mine level (Skull Cave level 1 is level 121)
[*]int [b]durability[/b]: how many hit points it has.
[*]string [b]expType[/b]: which skill to benefit from breaking this clump; one of "farming", "foraging" "mining", "combat".
[*]int [b]exp[/b]: how much experience to gain from destroying this node
[*]List<DropItem> [b]﻿dropItems[/b]: a list of items to drop (see below).
[/list]
The drop item list contains JSON objects with one item each that this node should drop, as follows:

[list]
[*]﻿"[b]itemIdOrName[/b]": The name or parent sheet index of the item to drop.
[*]"[b]dropChance[/b]": 0-100
[*]"[b]minAmount[/b]": minimum to drop.
[*]"[b]MaxAmount[/b]": maximum to drop.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Console Commands[/b][/size]

You can list id and index for all loaded clumps using:

[b]crc list[/b]

You can spawn a clump using

[b]crc spawn <id or index> <x> <y>[/b]

[size=5][b]Technical Notes[/b][/size]

Skull Cave seems to have boulders appear only very rarely. If you want to spawn these clumps more often, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5894]Custom Dungeon Floors[/url] which allows for spawning more clumps, among other things.

This mod no longer extends the sprite sheet [b]Maps\springobjects[/b], so it should no longer be in danger of conflict there.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Source code is available at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url].
